other_conditions: Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
Must be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Must be registered for a period of one year or more under the board.
Benefit is limited to a maximum of two children.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹8,000‑₹10,000 per child (up to two children), with a combined amount of ₹15,000 under the Mamata scheme.
